recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow source correction on the active FHIR-core search narrative and removes a contradiction that could cause implementers to read :missing as if it were :exists.
issue_request: FHIR-14955 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core-search and requested that undefined :exists examples in the Handling Missing Data section be corrected to :missing.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 13398, imported as git commit d3e942d297a66854a8caa2e77e25be969013947a, which changed clinical-status:exists=false examples to clinical-status:missing=true and changed nearby prose to :missing. Current source contains no literal :exists usages.
additional_context: Later modifier-page refactoring added a search modifier summary row whose description inverted the meaning of the missing modifier. The detailed missing section, FHIR-13348, and the 2018 Zulip thread all support missing=true as absent/no-value and missing=false as present.
reconciliation: Updated source/search.html so the missing modifier summary says the value is absent when the supplied parameter value is true and present when it is false.
source_changes: source/search.html: corrected the missing modifier summary row from present-when-true/absent-when-false to absent-when-true/present-when-false.

related_jiras.note: Published guidance confirms that :missing=true includes omitted elements and elements present only with extensions/no value.
Resolved-no-change default-values discussion mentioned the old :exists modifier, but did not require a separate current source decision.
